mappings.name: collections token: minted for any subscription key the rail knows

metadata.why: The adapter mints one of these before every call it has no cached token for. `expires_in` is MTN's documented hour; the adapter refreshes a minute early.

mappings.name: collections token: 'bad-key' is the subscription key the rail refuses

metadata.why: `bad_credentials_are_not_reported_as_a_payer_problem` in the conformance suite: credentials the rail rejects must surface as provider_account_blocked (severity Page), never as a decline. `bad-key` is the value that suite's `Credentials::Rejected` configures.
